_README.description: NVIDIA Nemotron via NIM OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, NVIDIA_API_KEY).
_README.usage: Base URL https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1. NIM model IDs use an org/model form. Scores pinned to the nvidia/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify slugs against /v1/models before relying on the direct route: on 2026-10-20 the public list included nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b and nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, but not nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b (it listed nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning instead).

models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL (120B-A12B, released 2026-10-15) - open multimodal MoE for text, images, documents, GUI screenshots and video. Direct NIM API; the slug is from NIM's public /v1/models list (read 2026-10-20) and is not live-tested yet. AA Intelligence Index 26 (one row).
